title: Sunday morning
summary: You are Sam. The kitchen is a disaster and the landlord is coming by at noon.

knows: The broken mug in the bin was Ana's doing.

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.desc: Two burners, a leaning stack of dishes, a window onto the bakery's chimney.

locations.name: Living Room
locations.desc: A sagging sofa, a plant nobody waters, the front door.

clocks.name: Landlord visit
clocks.fireText: The doorbell rings: Mr. Petrov, right on time, with a clipboard.

facts: Mr. Petrov texted that he will drop by at noon to look at the boiler.
opening: The kitchen smells of burnt toast and yesterday. Jo is standing at the sink holding a fork like it personally offended them. From the living room, Ana calls out that she definitely did not break anything.
